method: Authored specification walkthroughs against quoted mandatory source rules; no browser/runtime or independent stochastic run claimed. Root approved correction after review.
before_rules: Every active component should have an infinite loop state (Pulse, Typewriter, Float, Shimmer)
Never mount lists instantly — use cascade delays for waterfall reveals

cases.input: Write Stitch DESIGN.md for a dashboard whose user enables prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; preserve live job status.
cases.before_contract_problem: Mandatory perpetual motion has no reduced-motion exception.
cases.candidate_output: Remove nonessential movement and stagger; show static job-state text; content remains available.

cases.input: Describe a 2,000-row work-order list. Keyboard user must select the first row as soon as data arrives.
cases.before_contract_problem: Never mount lists instantly requires stagger regardless of interaction cost.
cases.candidate_output: Render available rows immediately with keyboard access; no mandatory entrance cascade or animation-dependent readiness.

cases.input: Describe a Save button in an existing Ceramic theme. It is enabled but idle.
cases.before_contract_problem: Every active component requires infinite looping without a meaningful ongoing state.
cases.candidate_output: Use inspected semantic component and motion contracts for finite press/focus feedback. Enabled idle state remains still.
